design.estimand: Effect of a teammate DRIVE preceding a PNR possession on the PPP of that PNR possession, compared to PNR possessions without a preceding DRIVE.
design.sample: All PNR possessions across NBA seasons 2022‑っ26, stratified by whether the immediately preceding possession was a DRIVE by a teammate (exposure) or not (control). Exclude possessions where labeling artifact evidence indicates unreliable PPP nonexistent or flagged as suspect.
